segments.sn1.2:1.2: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn1.2:2.1: “Jānāsi no tvaṃ, mārisa, sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan”ti?
segments.sn1.2:3.1: “Jānāmi khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan”ti.
segments.sn1.2:4.1: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, mārisa, jānāsi sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan”ti?

lines: Idāni dutiyasuttato paṭṭhāya paṭhamamāgatañca uttānatthañca pahāya yaṃ yaṃ anuttānaṃ, taṃ tadeva vaṇṇayissāma.
Maggena hi sattā kilesabandhanato nimuccanti, tasmā maggo sattānaṃ nimokkhoti vutto.
Phalakkhaṇe pana te kilesabandhanato pamuttā, tasmā phalaṃ sattānaṃ pamokkhoti vuttaṃ.
Nibbānaṃ patvā sattānaṃ sabbadukkhaṃ viviccati, tasmā nibbānaṃ vivekoti vuttaṃ.
Nibbānañhi patvā sattā sabbadukkhato nimuccanti pamuccanti viviccanti, tasmā tadeva “nimokkho pamokkho viveko”ti vuttaṃ.
Sattānaṃ nimokkhādijānanatthameva hi mayā samatiṃsa pāramiyo pūretvā sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ paṭividdhanti sīhanādaṃ nadati.
Tattha hi purimanaye nandībhavena tividhakammābhisaṅkhāravasena saṅkhārakkhandho gahito, saññāviññāṇehi taṃsampayuttā ca dve khandhā.
Tehi pana tīhi khandhehi sampayuttā vedanā tesaṃ gahaṇena gahitāvāti anupādiṇṇakānaṃ catunnaṃ arūpakkhandhānaṃ appavattivasena saupādisesaṃ nibbānaṃ kathitaṃ hoti.
Vedanānaṃ nirodhā upasamāti upādiṇṇakavedanānaṃ nirodhena ca upasamena ca.
Tattha vedanāgahaṇena taṃsampayuttā tayo khandhā gahitāva honti, tesaṃ vatthārammaṇavasena rūpakkhandhopi.
Evaṃ imesaṃ upādiṇṇakānaṃ pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ appavattivasena anupādisesaṃ nibbānaṃ kathitaṃ hoti.
Dutiyanaye pana nandiggahaṇena saṅkhārakkhandho gahito, bhavaggahaṇena upapattibhavasaṅkhāto rūpakkhandho, saññādīhi sarūpeneva tayo khandhā.
Evaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ appavattivasena nibbānaṃ kathitaṃ hotīti veditabbaṃ.
Noti pucchāyaṃ nu -saddena samānattho nipātoti āha “jānāsi noti jānāsi nū”ti.
So ca pamuccanti tenāti pamokkho, pamuccanante pana adhigantabbattāphalaṃ “pamokkho”ti vuttaṃ, yathā arahattaṃ “rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo”ti vuttaṃ.
Dutiyavikappe pana sakalavaṭṭadukkhato sattā nimuccanti ettha pamuccanti viviccanti cāti nimokkho pamokkho viveko, nibbānanti attho veditabbo.
Nandīmūlako bhavo nandībhavo purimapade uttarapadalopena “sākabhakkho patthavo sākapatthavo”ti yathā.
Paṭhamaṃ kammavaṭṭapadhānaṃ atthaṃ vatvā puna kilesakammānaṃ vasena ubhayappadhānaṃ atthaṃ vadanto “nandiyā cā”tiādimāha.
Tividhakammābhisaṅkhāravasenāti puññābhisaṅkhārādivasena kāyasaṅkhārādivasena ca tippakārassa kammābhisaṅkhārassa vasena.
Taṃsampayuttā cāti tena yathāvuttasaṅkhārakkhandhena samaṃ yuttā eva.
